title: 第1390章 屁滚尿流第1389章 古宗弟子
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: 他们可是高高在上的古宗弟子啊，怎么能够被人如此羞辱呢？
先是被打脸便也罢了，竟然还被用脚踩着，这绝对是他们此生都从未经历过的奇耻大辱。
“呵呵，看来你们还是不太清醒，没有看清楚局势啊，既然如此，那我便让你们好好的清醒清醒。”
李轩看到两人都被踩在了脚下，竟然还敢如此嘴硬，立即冷笑一声，抬脚便再次狠踹了过去。
他那硕大的脚掌，就犹如是蒲扇一般，狠狠的印在两人脸上。
刹那间，啪啪啪啪的声音不断传出，两人顿时惨叫着在地上翻滚了起来，吐出了满口的血牙。
他们也不是没有想过反抗，然而却是根本就无用。
同为至仙境，他们的修为甚至还要比李轩高出一些。
可面对李轩，他们就犹如是在面对一座无法跨越的神山，根本就没有半分的反抗能力。
不得不说，这实在是太屈辱了，李轩直接用最简单粗暴的方式，将他们这些自视清高的古宗弟子，踏落了神坛。
“还是不肯说吗？若如此，那我可就要送你们上路了。”
李轩眼神冷漠，一边抬脚猛踹着二人，一边继续冰冷的开口。
他已经有些不耐烦了。
事实上，从这两人的手段，以及那高高在上的态度和只言片语，他也猜到了二人身份，绝对是来自帝坟宗。
只是他却不清楚，帝坟宗的人为何要来找他的麻烦，他似乎并没有得罪过帝坟宗吧？
最关键的是，外面那尊疑似帝坟宗大能的白裙少女，甚至还出手帮过他呢，他对此很是疑惑不解，所以想要搞清楚这些事情
赵超和王越被李轩如此羞辱，虽然心中早已经是怒火冲天，但感受到李轩的不耐和身上的杀意，最终还是乖乖的妥协了。
他们开始满脸憋屈的回答起了李轩的问题。
片刻后，李轩听完两人的回答，脸色不由的阴沉了下来。
我操，那神秘老妪害人不浅啊，竟然要他来迎娶帝坟宗的圣女，而且还是仙王境圣女，这不是在坑人吗？
最关键的是，为了此事，帝坟宗竟然有无数妖孽出山，都要来针对他，这更是简直离了大谱，无妄之灾啊！
“滚吧，记住不要再来招惹我，否则，我不介意打掉你们所有的牙齿！”
李轩的心情有些糟糕，他很是不爽的看了两人一眼，飞起两脚将二人踢飞，然后便是消失在了原地。
“王八蛋，你欺人太甚！”
“混账东西，你给我等着，此仇不报，誓不为人！”
赵超和王越怎么都没有想到，自己都已经被如此羞辱，且还老实回答了李轩的问题，最后还是被各自送了一脚。
他们简直气的都快要冒烟了，只可惜实力不如人，他们也无可奈何，只能在心中无能狂怒。
“李轩，你太过分了。”
李轩在踢飞赵超和王越之后，才刚走几步，一道冰冷的声音就传入了耳中。
他抬头看去，只见前方出现了一名身穿黑衣的短发青年。
这短发青年看上去很是精悍，体内似乎蕴含有无尽恐怖的力量，虽没有刻意爆发气势，但还是给了人一种气势如虹的压迫感。
在短发青年的手中，还提着一柄乌黑色的长棍，长棍散发出了道道幽光，甚至比他的身体还要高。
这短发青年整个给人的感觉，就好似是一座火山，仿佛随时都会爆发一般，很是不简单。
“你是谁？”
李轩看着短发青年，声音平淡的问道。
短发青年听到此话，轻蔑一笑，以一种高高在上的口吻说道：
“你记住了，我名为岳然，而你刚才击败的那两个废物，则是我的师弟，今日，你能败在我的手中，也算你之荣幸。”
content_en:
They are disciples of the ancient sect who are so superior, how could they be so humiliated?
First they were slapped in the face, but then they were stepped on with their feet. This was definitely a shame and humiliation they had never experienced in their lives.
"Haha, it seems that you are still not quite sober and have not seen the situation clearly. In that case, I will let you sober up."
Li Xuan saw that both of them were being stepped on and how dared to be so harsh. He immediately sneered, raised his foot and kicked them hard again.
His huge soles were like cattail fans, stamping hard on their faces.
In an instant, the sound of snapping was heard continuously, and the two of them screamed and rolled on the ground, spitting out a mouth full of bloody teeth.
It's not like they didn't think about resisting, but it was useless.
They are both in the Immortal Realm, and their cultivation levels are even higher than Li Xuan's.
But facing Li Xuan, they were like facing an insurmountable mountain, with no ability to resist at all.
I have to say that this was really humiliating. Li Xuan directly used the simplest and crudest method to knock these self-esteemed disciples of the ancient sect off the altar.
"Are you still unwilling to say it? If so, then I will send you on your way."
Li Xuan's eyes were cold, and he kicked the two of them fiercely while continuing to speak coldly.
He was already a little impatient.
In fact, from the methods of these two people, as well as their condescending attitudes and few words, he also guessed their identities, and they were definitely from the Emperor's Tomb Sect.
But he didn't know why the people from the Emperor's Tomb Sect came to trouble him. He didn't seem to have offended the Emperor's Tomb Sect, right?
The most important thing is that the girl in white dress outside, who is suspected to be a powerful person from the Emperor's Tomb Sect, even helped him. He was very confused about this, so he wanted to find out these things.
Zhao Chao and Wang Yue were so humiliated by Li Xuan. Although their hearts were already filled with rage, they felt Li Xuan's impatience and murderous intent, so they finally compromised obediently.
They began to answer Li Xuan's questions with aggrieved expressions.
After a while, Li Xuan's expression turned gloomy after hearing the two people's answers.
Damn it, that mysterious old woman did a lot of harm to people. She actually asked him to marry a saint from the Imperial Tomb Sect, and she was also a saint from the Immortal King Realm. Isn’t this a trick?
The most important thing is that because of this matter, countless demons from the Emperor's Tomb Sect came out to target him. This was completely off the mark and an unreasonable disaster!
"Go away, and remember not to provoke me again, otherwise, I won't mind knocking out all your teeth!"
Li Xuan was in a bad mood. He glanced at the two of them very unhappily, kicked them away with two feet, and then disappeared from the place.
"You bastard, you're going too far!"
"You bastard, just wait for me. If you don't avenge me, I will never be a human being!"
Zhao Chao and Wang Yue never expected that they had been humiliated in this way, and they answered Li Xuan's questions honestly, but in the end they were kicked by each other.
They were so angry that they were about to smoke. Unfortunately, they were not as strong as others. They had no choice but to be helpless and furious in their hearts.
"Li Xuan, you have gone too far."
After Li Xuan kicked Zhao Chao and Wang Yue away, he had just taken a few steps when a cold voice came into his ears.
He looked up and saw a young man with short hair in black appearing in front of him.
This short-haired young man looks very capable, and his body seems to contain endless terrifying power. Although he does not deliberately explode his momentum, he still gives people a sense of pressure like a rainbow.
In the hand of the short-haired young man, he also held a long black stick. The long stick emitted rays of light and was even taller than his body.
This short-haired young man gives the impression that he is a volcano, as if he is about to erupt at any time, which is not simple.
"Who are you?"
Li Xuan looked at the short-haired young man and asked in a calm voice.
When the short-haired young man heard this, he smiled contemptuously and said in a condescending tone:
"You remember, my name is Yue Ran, and the two losers you just defeated are my junior brothers. It is an honor for you to be defeated by me today."
